about: Recorded from mtg-graph-api (branch dt-6.1-store, port source rework/ts-card-graph a000f59: strategy.ts, profile.ts, interact.ts, closure.ts unchanged) on the card store's inputs: the corpus, Scryfall oracle file and subtype facts cards.db was built from, and the EDHREC commander pages on disk. Card order in the graph follows the corpus; the port's follows store ids, so compare by card identity.
